data.name: Houda
data.long_meaning: The name Houda is derived from the Arabic word 'hudaa', which means guide, path, or direction. This name is often given to girls as a reminder of the importance of guidance and following the righteous path in life.

in_urdu.name: ہدہ
in_urdu.meaning: ہدہ کا مطلب ہے رہنمائی اور صحیح راستے کی طرف ہدایت
